'''''Ne Ganna Dateel Jabba''''' was the name of an artwork which decorated one of the walls of the [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt's]] luxury [[Sail barge/Legends|sail barge]], the [[Khetanna/Legends|''Khetanna'']].

The piece was hand-carved by slaves of a Huttese artist named [[Dreyba]] and depicted Jabba in an apparently content mood, surrounded by [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] girls and drinking from a jug. Two girls appeared to be holding fans. The scene took place either inside of a tent or underneath a canopy, and cushions appeared to be spread across the ground.

The artwork was destroyed along with the whole sail barge and its passengers, after a trip to the [[Great Pit of Carkoon/Legends|Great Pit of Carkoon]] went horribly wrong. Jabba's prisoners, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] managed to escape his entourage, leaving Jabba dead and the barge blasted to pieces by its own defensive laser cannon.
